description: Database schema + model foundation for the lifecycle. Adds the missing columns (tutor_joined_at, student_joined_at, actual_start_at, actual_end_at, delivery_status) and the 'partial' status value; updates Booking model helpers; fixes premature tutor wallet credit in BookingService.
steps: Create migration `database/migrations/2026_11_10_000001_add_lifecycle_columns_to_bookings.php`. In up(): use Schema::table('bookings', ...) with hasColumn guards. Add: `$table->timestamp('tutor_joined_at')->nullable()->after('tutor_joined')`, `$table->timestamp('student_joined_at')->nullable()->after('student_joined')`, `$table->timestamp('actual_start_at')->nullable()->after('completed_at')`, `$table->timestamp('actual_end_at')->nullable()->after('actual_start_at')`, `$table->string('delivery_status', 20)->nullable()->after('actual_end_at')`. ALSO alter the status enum to add 'partial' and 'no_show' if not present (check existing enum: pending|confirmed|cancelled|completed|no_show — 'no_show' exists, only 'partial' is missing). Use DB::statement("ALTER TABLE bookings MODIFY COLUMN status ENUM('pending','confirmed','cancelled','completed','no_show','partial') DEFAULT 'pending'") wrapped in a hasColumn guard.

Create migration `database/migrations/2026_11_10_000002_add_no_show_to_refunds_reason.php`. Alter refunds.reason enum to add 'no_show': DB::statement("ALTER TABLE refunds MODIFY COLUMN reason ENUM('first_20min_guarantee','tutor_cancelled','technical_issue','quality_issue','other','no_show')").

Create migration `database/migrations/2026_11_10_000003_add_tutor_feedback_to_bookings.php`. Add: `$table->text('tutor_feedback')->nullable()` and `$table->tinyInteger('tutor_rating')->nullable()` to bookings table.
Run `php artisan migrate` to apply all three migrations.

Modify `app/Models/Booking.php`: add new columns to $fillable array: 'tutor_joined_at', 'student_joined_at', 'actual_start_at', 'actual_end_at', 'delivery_status', 'tutor_feedback', 'tutor_rating'. Add to $casts: 'tutor_joined_at' => 'datetime', 'student_joined_at' => 'datetime', 'actual_start_at' => 'datetime', 'actual_end_at' => 'datetime', 'tutor_rating' => 'integer'. Add helper methods: scheduledEndAt() returns $this->scheduled_at->copy()->addMinutes($this->duration_minutes); isRoomOpen() returns now()->between($this->scheduled_at->copy()->subMinutes(5), $this->scheduledEndAt()->copy()->addMinutes(30)); deliveredMinutes() returns ($this->actual_start_at && $this->actual_end_at) ? $this->actual_start_at->diffInMinutes($this->actual_end_at) : 0; deliveryPercent() returns $this->duration_minutes > 0 ? ($this->deliveredMinutes() / $this->duration_minutes * 100) : 0. Replace existing canJoin() body to: return $this->status === 'confirmed' && $this->isRoomOpen();

Modify `app/Services/BookingService.php` confirmBooking() method: REMOVE the entire block that does `Wallet::firstOrCreate(...)` and `$wallet->credit(...)` inside the DB::transaction. Also remove `$booking->tutor->tutorProfile?->increment('total_sessions')` from inside the transaction (it can stay after the transaction if desired, but the wallet credit must be removed entirely from confirmBooking). Leave the rest of confirmBooking untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Running `php artisan migrate` exits 0 with no errors
Running `php artisan tinker --execute="App\\Models\\Booking::first()->scheduledEndAt()"` returns a Carbon datetime without error
Running `php artisan tinker --execute="App\\Models\\Booking::first()->canJoin()"` returns a boolean without error
Calling BookingService::confirmBooking() on a pending booking does NOT create a wallet_transactions row
Bookings table has columns: tutor_joined_at, student_joined_at, actual_start_at, actual_end_at, delivery_status, tutor_feedback, tutor_rating
Bookings status enum accepts 'partial' without a DB error
verification: php artisan route:clear && php artisan config:clear
